components.name: Directory entry
components.description: Ruled row pairing a code with its destination.

narrative.overview: A quiet, precise index: codes, destinations, and practical guidance are the material.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled entries instead of cards for the directory.
One blue link color against cool, neutral surfaces.
A legible light and dark version of the same structure.
dos: Do keep link codes and destinations readable together.
Do use shared color roles so light and dark modes retain the same hierarchy.
donts: Don't hide destinations behind decorative cards or rely on color alone for keyboard focus.
